name: qkd_astk_ctl-ks1-53707518d
purpose: Qwen ROM TP8 (track B) aggregator strip: the stack's port qkd_astk_ctl (one a strip, hub end): q / start / T in, the layer word to the landing strip, the hub words (lmax, Z block sums through a 16-entry queue, Z done, the P.V beats assembled from the X / Y lanes), the K-pass completion count, the group count for the tree cells, the fault OR.  4.9k sinks.
